title: Chapter 466
paragraphs: Chapter 466
Episode 131. People with good intuition, people with bad intuition (10)
The black tidal wave, which started from the sky, is covering the ground.
From the perspective of the four major forces hastily casting a protective barrier, that's exactly what it looked like. The ruthless black tidal wave seemed to annihilate the entire island.
Due to the attribute of suppression contained in the blue flames, there was also a sense of weight as if a mountain was pressing down.
Creak, crack!

Even before the Upwha reached the ground, huge fissures appeared in various parts of the island, and people on the ground couldn't help but think that this was what it would look like if they were facing the end of the world.
Indeed, if the protective barriers of the four major forces couldn't hold up, the Upwha unleashed by Murakan had enough power to erase the entire island and still have more strength left.
It was because a kind of amplification effect had occurred.
In other words, Murakan's spirit (which had regained about half of its strength) was added to the Upwha that Jin had unleashed.
Instead of eroding and nullifying each other, Upwha and spirit combined, as if it was planned from the beginning, to show even more powerful force.
Even the Upwha unleashed by Jin alone had the power to turn the guardians in the Garden of Swords into ashes at that time, if Runtia hadn't stopped it.
Let alone the Upwha with the addition of Murakan's power, it was needless to say.
Of course, it was still not comparable to what Sara had displayed in her heyday, but it had reached a level that was nearly on par with it.
In other words, among the four major forces that had come to Kundo, there was no one who could single-handedly stop this Upwha.
Whirl, clatter-!
The Upwha began to ravage the ground.
As soon as the tip of the black tidal wave began to sweep the barriers, the people on the ground had no choice but to tremble in terror and shock.
The dozens of layers of barriers, which were not the best but were cast by the first-tier forces of the four major powers, were easily shattered like dry leaves.
Snap, crack, pop!
The shattered fragments of the barrier flew and reflected light. It took less than a second for the pitch-black Upwha to block all light and bring darkness.
"Aaaaah!"
"Cough!"
Screams erupted simultaneously.

The Upwha turned everything it touched into ashes. Just touching the tip of a finger would cause the entire body to corrode, and due to the pressure, there was no way to escape. Even if they could escape, it would be hard for them to find any meaning in doing so.
The people under the black tidal wave felt as if they were standing in a scene from hell.

And if there was a god in that hell, it was the thought of the terrifying Black Dragon, Murakan, who was laughing madly while watching the burning humans (in reality, his gaze was fixed nowhere in particular).
[Kuhahaha, kuhahak, kahahahahak!]
Though the laughter expressed uncontrollable joy, the people on the ground couldn't accept it as such.
A chilling existence that could slaughter the first-tier forces of the four major powers as easily as crushing ants...
"Krark! Kid, do you really have to fight that thing? That black dragon could cause real trouble if we mess with it. If you want to be like Myron, I can recommend many other ways."
As Sandra cast an ice barrier spell to repel the black flames, she shouted. Sweat flowed down her face like rain as she pushed back the black blaze.
"Every day, I imagined... killing those bastards... the enemies of Myron!"
Midoro was using space explosion and fire magic to protect himself and nearby magicians.
"Really? It would be hard to find a funny guy like you as Myron's enemy. You talk as if you're his brother or something!"
Contrary to her words, Sandra didn't ridicule him at all, but instead used a strangely lively tone.
"Whatever, do as you please! With your skills, even if you die and come back, it's unlikely. I've always wanted to meet Jin Runkandel, though... Aaaah!"
Suddenly, without warning, the black flames intensified, and Sandra screamed.
The elder magicians around her, who couldn't quickly adapt to the change, were all swallowed by the aura and disappeared.
With just one amplification, Zipfel's side lost nearly half of their magicians.
Still, Sandra only managed a smirk.
"Phew, I almost went too. It's fascinating, really!"
The situation for Kinjelo's side was even worse.
Unlike the White Wolf tribe, the Red Wolf tribe members were not helpful in dealing with the situation.
No, there were more than a few Red Wolves who, in their frenzy, brought death to the White Wolves like drowning men.
"You crazy Red Wolves! Let go! Let go!"
"Please, save me! I was wrong! I won't do it again!"
"What do you mean, you won't do it again!"
"Save me too, Kruagh!"
"Because of you guys, our brethren are dying...!"
Eventually, the White Wolf tribe's top warriors and high-ranking warriors had no choice but to strike the heads of the interfering Red Wolves with a hammer.
If they didn't, total annihilation was certain. Occasionally, some king-ranked Red Wolves fought back, but their claw swings, devoid of reason, posed little threat to the White Wolves.
Despite the generally poor relationship between the two tribes, the White Wolves couldn't help but feel it was a waste to kill the Red Wolves.
'Damn it! It's such a waste for soldiers who could contribute to the great cause to die like this...!'
It was especially painful to lose the king-ranked Red Wolves so pointlessly. The king's title was given only to those who had combat power comparable to the 'top warriors' of the White Wolves.
The heads and torsos of Red Wolves flew in all directions and disappeared into the black flames. The relatively less powerful White Wolves were also dying continuously.
As Kinjelo struggled through the chaos, the members of Bimont were also enduring a terrible time.
'It was absurd enough to fight Amela all the way, and now it's Black Dragon Murakan...!'
The 3rd Squad Leader Ratz of the Special Forces gritted his teeth as he thought.
Like the other factions, the members of Biment did not imagine that such a situation would occur when they searched for the Gaipa Military Road.
Who could have imagined that Amela would engage in battle with all four major forces, even casting a curse?
Although there were minor power struggles among the four major forces, they never thought that they would have a full-scale battle.

Everyone was certain to be cautious, as it would be a massive loss for all parties involved if it escalated to an actual battle. Regardless of who obtained Amela, they would rather negotiate than fight.
Yet, they did not expect such a wide-scale attack to happen.
What's more, the attack had just begun, and Murakan was already overwhelming the four major forces.
Ratz and the other squad leaders couldn't help but feel dizzy as they watched their members die without a break.

It was not just one or two. They couldn't even begin to estimate the amount of time and budget it would take to replenish such a large number of special forces. It was also uncertain whether they would be able to survive and return to the empire.
Gipel, Kinjello, and Biment.
The three factions naturally believed that the wildfire was Murakan's technique, but Runkandel had a different judgment.
'It's not Murakan's power... It's the power of the youngest one!'
Vugo cut through the wildfire, swallowing his dry saliva.
Although it was slightly different from what he had displayed at the declaration of the family head, Vugo was well aware that the wildfire was a sword technique.
'It has a greater power than what Runtia blocked at that time, but it's clear. This isn't Murakan, it's the youngest one's sword!'
A chilling sensation ran down his spine as if the cold blade had grazed his lower back.
Moreover, various emotions such as a strange sense of defeat, admiration, shame, self-loathing, and fighting spirit were intertwined, creating indescribable feelings.
The black waves of wildfire were spreading particularly weakly towards Runkandel.
Of course, it was Murakan who adjusted it, but Vugo mistakenly thought that Jin was taking care of him and his family.
Regardless, unlike the other factions, not a single death had occurred in Runkandel.
In other words, the lives of the Runkandel knights depended on Jin. If Jin wanted them dead, they would die, and if he wanted them alive, they would live.
[Yes, feel it! You insignificant creatures. Die experiencing the power of the great Black Dragon; it will be the greatest moment of your worthless lives.]
Murakan paused his laughter and said so.
He looked at the ground with a rather contented expression as the wildfire raged. He was admiring his enhanced power.
A thrilling sensation and an involuntary smile crossed his face. His wide-open mouth had no dignity, but fortunately, no one could see his face as they were busy blocking the wildfire.
Only one person, Jin, looked up at him and let out a sigh of relief.
"That guy seems to have suddenly become incredibly strong. What's going on? It feels like some sort of limit has been lifted."
Regardless of the reason, it was a good thing without a doubt.
Amela was saved, Murakan became stronger, and they unintentionally created a situation where they overwhelmed the four major factions.
He quickly thought about how to gain the most benefits. There wasn't much to ponder.
"Amela."
[Yes, no. Uh. Th-thank you for saving me.]
"We will save the greetings and detailed discussion for after the situation is resolved. Instead, I am going to make you an offer right now."
[Tell me anything! I'll be your friend now, not a friend of Bubar and Kinjello.]
"That remains to be seen. It is also important whether I can accept you as a friend. Anyway, hide yourself."
Whoosh!
[Meow!]
Shuri was summoned from the red jade. As soon as Amela saw Shuri, her eyes sparkled just like when she saw the Prochi siblings.
"This one will help you. Hide yourself as quickly as possible before the chaos subsides. Somewhere not too far from the military road, until I say it's okay for me to come out."
Jin intended to make Amela a 'dead person.'
Since Amela had already turned her back on the four major factions, he decided it would be better to label her as dead and secretly affiliate her with his own forces.
Of course, that was a story for after he could trust Amela, but there would be no chance for Amela to hide after the wildfire ended.
[With this one? Really? Can I take the cuties with me?]
"No, you cannot. And if you deceive me or run away, no matter where you are or whose protection you're under, I will definitely find you and kill..."
[There won't be such a thing! See you later.]
[Meow meow!]
As Amela left riding Shuri, Jin could see Bubar's soul, which was tied up with the Prochi siblings, fading away at a rapid speed.
'I'll hear about that directly from Amela later... Now, let's finish cleaning up here.'
Jin and Murakan's eyes met.
And Jin conveyed this message to Murakan through his lip movements.
'Prepare the third line, Murakan.'
